name: HENGHUI Technology Corporation Limited
summary: HENGHUI Technology Corporation Limited engages in the production, packaging, testing, and sale of integrated circuit product packaging materials in China and internationally. It offers flexible leadframe products, including 6pin ultra-thin gold-plated smart card tape, single interface gold-plated mart card tape, single interface palladium-plated smart card tape, dual interface gold-plated and palladium-plated smart card tape, customized products, alloy tape, and PTH technology-coupled products. The company also provides contactless, 6pin contact, 8pin contact, 6pin dual-interface, and 8pin dual-interface smart card modules; and leadframe pand eSIM assemble products.
